entities.summary: Zhang Yihe is a Chinese writer, memoirist, and scholar of Peking opera and traditional Chinese theatre. She is best known for her vivid, memoir-style accounts of Chinese intellectuals and artists who suffered during the Anti-Rightist Campaign in the 1950s and the Cultural Revolution. As the daughter of prominent democratic politician and "Number One Rightist" Zhang Bojun, she herself was imprisoned for ten years during the Cultural Revolution. She is a graduate of the National Academy of Chinese Theatre Arts.
